title: Code questions answered from the map are measured against reading files, per right answer
goal: The lookup benchmark has a pool of code questions about this repository (where a symbol is defined, who calls it, which docs describe a file), run with the kb tools including the code-map call against tools=files, recorded under a spend cap the operator's gate names; the report and token-efficiency.md state tokens and USD per right answer for both arms with their spread.

run: import csv,subprocess as s,sys;r=[x for x in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if 'code' in x['case'] and x['scenario']=='multi'];arms={x['arm'] for x in r};print(len(r),sorted(arms));p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/benchmarks.py','report','--check'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=600);print(p.stdout[-300:]);t=open('kb/_self/token-efficiency.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if len(arms)>=2 and p.returncode==0 and 'code-lookups' in t else 1)
